title: Shrinkflation Cases (ShrinkRadar)
subtitle: Documented package-size cuts with sources, prices and dates
description:
Every row is a shrinkflation case: a product whose net quantity went down, as reported by a consumer agency (Verbraucherzentrale Hamburg, Consumentenbond, Which?, CHOICE, Consumer NZ), the Mouse Print* archive or a news investigation, and checked by ShrinkRadar against the fetched source. Fields include size before/after, size cut %, hidden unit-price rise at the same price, shelf prices before/after where recorded, real per-unit price change, country, date, source and source URL. Coverage follows the sources (Germany and the Netherlands are over-represented), so it is a record of reported cases, not a random sample.

Live, always-current copy and field documentation: https://shrinkradar.com/data/ . Licence CC BY 4.0: please credit ShrinkRadar (shrinkradar.com).
